axes.read: Late-inning volatility: bullpen flip, reliever command risk, and middle-relief mistake exposure.

axes.label: Flow
axes.read: Phase agreement: whether full game, first five, late, and bridge point in the same direction.

gameProfile.label: Early-pressure side
gameProfile.bestExpression: Full-game side only if early traffic appears; live entry preferred

laneMap.side: Allowed after early traffic confirms the pressure read.
laneMap.first5: Only primary if the line is cheaper than full-game ML.
laneMap.firstInning: YRFI only if both top orders and starter leakage agree.

inningMap.expectation: Tigers needs the first traffic pocket.
inningMap.watch: No early baserunners means the edge decays quickly.

inningMap.expectation: First-five side is the cleanest expression.
inningMap.watch: Do not wait for late rescue if the starter edge is gone.

inningMap.expectation: Only keep full-game exposure if the bridge is not leaking.
inningMap.watch: A bullpen mismatch turns this into a hedge spot.

inningMap.expectation: Closeout depends on lead size more than raw team rating.
inningMap.watch: One-run late leads are not a free pass.

marketImplications.side: Tigers is more coherent as a side because the game shape mostly agrees with the projection.
marketImplications.first5: First-five can stay live if starter hold and top-order pressure both agree.
marketImplications.total: Totals need chaos-gate respect; raw run projection is not enough when one-bad-inning or warm-carry risk is live.
marketImplications.firstInning: NRFI is the timing lane to compare against the side; modeled chance 40.6% YRFI.

rfLens.trustedUse: Use RF as a nonlinear totals/game-shape check first. Do not let it pick ML/F5 by itself yet.
rfLens.totalsRead: RF totals baseline supports treating the raw total as shape-sensitive, not automatic.
rfLens.moneylineRead: RF moneyline history is not deployable; it can only flag disagreement for review.
rfLens.first5Read: RF first-five history is not deployable; use it as a timing warning, not a pick.
rfLens.firstInningRead: RF first-inning history is not deployable; keep it behind explicit early-run features.
